# CLI for OpenArch

> openarch, the CLI for OpenArch, is a command line tool to install and run Hyland OpenArch (https://github.com/hyland/OpenArch) with Docker Compose. Not an official Hyland product: an AlfrescoLabs project that Hyland does not officially support. Every command supports --output json, and the exit codes are stable.

How to call it from a program or an AI agent:

- Add --output json (or set OPENARCH_OUTPUT=json). stdout then holds exactly one JSON document, also for errors: {"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "hint": "..."}}. Logs and warnings go to stderr.
- Add --non-interactive, so that no command waits for input.
- Pass passwords on stdin (--password-stdin, --admin-password-stdin), never as arguments.
- Run 'openarch help --output json' for every command, flag, default value, allowed value and exit code. 'openarch <command> --help --output json' describes one command.
- Start with 'openarch doctor', then 'openarch init --dir <folder> --non-interactive', then 'openarch up --dir <folder>'.
- For MCP clients, 'openarch mcp --dir <folder>' runs an MCP server on stdio with the same commands as tools (add --listen <port> for Streamable HTTP with a bearer token from 'openarch mcp token'). Add --allow-destructive for down, clean, restore and the other tools that delete data.
- For coding agents that read Agent Skills, 'openarch skill install' writes .claude/skills/openarch/SKILL.md with the install flow and the fixes for common failures.
- Plugins: 'openarch <name>' runs an executable named openarch-<name> from PATH. 'openarch plugin list' shows them.

## Exit codes

- 0 ok: OK
- 1 error: Error
- 2 usage: Bad usage or input
- 3 prerequisite: A prerequisite is missing
- 4 unhealthy: A service is not healthy
- 5 remote: Remote API error
- 6 auth: Authentication failed

## Commands

- [openarch api](commands/openarch_api.md): Call the OpenArch API
- [openarch api ping](commands/openarch_api_ping.md): Check that OpenArch answers and that the credentials work
- [openarch backup](commands/openarch_backup.md): Back up MongoDB, the OpenArch files and the OpenSearch indices
- [openarch clean](commands/openarch_clean.md): Stop OpenArch and delete its data
- [openarch completion](commands/openarch_completion.md): Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
- [openarch completion bash](commands/openarch_completion_bash.md): Generate the autocompletion script for bash
- [openarch completion fish](commands/openarch_completion_fish.md): Generate the autocompletion script for fish
- [openarch completion powershell](commands/openarch_completion_powershell.md): Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
- [openarch completion zsh](commands/openarch_completion_zsh.md): Generate the autocompletion script for zsh
- [openarch config](commands/openarch_config.md): Manage saved connections (contexts)
- [openarch config delete](commands/openarch_config_delete.md): Delete a context and its stored passwords
- [openarch config get](commands/openarch_config_get.md): Show a context
- [openarch config list](commands/openarch_config_list.md): List the contexts
- [openarch config set](commands/openarch_config_set.md): Save a remote connection and its password
- [openarch config use](commands/openarch_config_use.md): Select the current context
- [openarch config whoami](commands/openarch_config_whoami.md): Show which URL and user a command would use, and where they come from
- [openarch credentials](commands/openarch_credentials.md): Show the users and passwords of a local workspace
- [openarch demo](commands/openarch_demo.md): Add sample users and documents that show permission-aware search
- [openarch demo load](commands/openarch_demo_load.md): Create the demo folders and documents
- [openarch demo reset](commands/openarch_demo_reset.md): Delete the demo folders and documents
- [openarch demo users](commands/openarch_demo_users.md): Add the demo users and a context for each one
- [openarch doctor](commands/openarch_doctor.md): Check the prerequisites to run OpenArch
- [openarch documents](commands/openarch_documents.md): Get, create, list, upload and download documents
- [openarch documents content](commands/openarch_documents_content.md): Download the file of a document
- [openarch documents create](commands/openarch_documents_create.md): Create a document under a parent
- [openarch documents get](commands/openarch_documents_get.md): Show a document
- [openarch documents list](commands/openarch_documents_list.md): List the documents in a folder
- [openarch documents update](commands/openarch_documents_update.md): Change the properties of a document
- [openarch documents upload](commands/openarch_documents_upload.md): Upload a file as a new document
- [openarch down](commands/openarch_down.md): Stop OpenArch and remove its containers, keeping the data
- [openarch init](commands/openarch_init.md): Create an OpenArch workspace
- [openarch logs](commands/openarch_logs.md): Show the logs of the services
- [openarch mcp](commands/openarch_mcp.md): Run an MCP server that exposes the commands as tools
- [openarch mcp token](commands/openarch_mcp_token.md): Print the bearer token of 'openarch mcp --listen'
- [openarch migrate](commands/openarch_migrate.md): Update openarch.yaml to the schema of this openarch
- [openarch plugin](commands/openarch_plugin.md): List the plugins that extend openarch
- [openarch plugin list](commands/openarch_plugin_list.md): List the openarch-<name> executables on PATH
- [openarch query](commands/openarch_query.md): Run a query and list the documents found
- [openarch render](commands/openarch_render.md): Write the workspace files again from openarch.yaml
- [openarch restore](commands/openarch_restore.md): Replace the data of the workspace with a backup
- [openarch secrets](commands/openarch_secrets.md): Manage the passwords of a workspace
- [openarch secrets rotate](commands/openarch_secrets_rotate.md): Give new passwords to the users of OpenArch, MongoDB and OpenSearch
- [openarch self-update](commands/openarch_self-update.md): Replace this binary with the latest release
- [openarch skill](commands/openarch_skill.md): Install the Agent Skill that teaches AI coding agents to use openarch
- [openarch skill install](commands/openarch_skill_install.md): Write the skill to .claude/skills/openarch/SKILL.md
- [openarch skill show](commands/openarch_skill_show.md): Print the skill
- [openarch smoke-test](commands/openarch_smoke-test.md): Check OpenArch end to end: create, read, query and delete a document
- [openarch status](commands/openarch_status.md): Show the state of each service and of the OpenArch API
- [openarch up](commands/openarch_up.md): Start OpenArch and wait until it is healthy
- [openarch upgrade](commands/openarch_upgrade.md): Change the OpenArch version and check the result
- [openarch users](commands/openarch_users.md): Manage the OpenArch users of a workspace
- [openarch users add](commands/openarch_users_add.md): Add a user
- [openarch users delete](commands/openarch_users_delete.md): Delete a user
- [openarch users list](commands/openarch_users_list.md): List the users
- [openarch users set-password](commands/openarch_users_set-password.md): Change the password of a user
- [openarch version](commands/openarch_version.md): Print version information
